slug: 2025-03-25 La Centrafrique lance officiellement e-Tax, sa plateforme de paiement d'impots en ligne

facts.fact: Agence Ecofin reports the DGID launched the e-Tax platform on 24 March 2025, providing online tax declaration.
Agence Ecofin reports the DGID launched the e-Tax platform on 24 March 2025 for online payment of taxes.
